rules.description: Full NGDA noun systems apply the image-checked stem and declared class. Gehīersumnes and ręst have singular abstract production; plural morphology is recognition reference without a new count sense.

Fōt has fēt in selected dative singular and nominative/accusative plural; fōt- in other ending-bearing cells. Fōte is an accepted dative alternative and fōtas an occasional plural, not the selected recall form.

Fēond has selected fēonde dative singular, fīend nominative/accusative plural and fēonda genitive plural. Cook and Wright document other dative/plural realizations; do not substitute the genitive -endra of a different -end family.

Hęre and sciphęre have the complete selected ordinary -e masculine pattern. Cook44.2 explicitly permits expanded hęrg-/hęrig- before singular endings and hęrg-/hęrig-/hęrige- before plural endings; apply the same rule within sciphęre. Variants are accepted without testing independent recall.

Ēðel, sāwol and wǣpen have ending-bearing ēðl-, sāwl- and wǣpn-. Hærfest and pęning retain the medial vowel; the short second syllable is required for the ordinary syncope rule. Wǣpnu is the selected plural beside explicit wǣp(e)n alternatives.
Andwlita and sǣdtīma use the weak masculine pattern. Fǣmne and heorte use the weak feminine pattern, with fǣmn- and heort- before endings. Gehīersumnes doubles final s before endings.

Brād, beald, earg, ēaðmōd and mildheort use the complete long strong model and the weak model. Īsern and ēadig use the selected disyllabic short-model endings, retaining their medial vowel; ēadig has expressly documented optional syncope. Strong/weak choice and ordinary agreement remain prior rules.
